notes: Labelled calibration set for the energy retailer checklist v1.
expected_checks records the verdict a human auditor gave for that check code. Only labelled
checks are scored; unlabelled checks are ignored so the set can grow incrementally.
Calibration sampling is disabled when scoring this set so gate expectations stay deterministic.
All names, addresses, emails and identifiers are synthetic test data.

segments: Good afternoon, my name is Sarah Jenkins and I am calling on behalf of your energy comparison service.
This call is being recorded for training and quality assurance purposes.
Can I confirm that you are the account holder or authorised to make changes on this account?
Yes that's correct, John Smith speaking.
Thank you. I have your supply address as 12 Rose Street Richmond.
Can I confirm your date of birth please?
Thank you. Your NMI is 6102123456 and this is an electricity only plan.
This is the Origin Solar Boost Electricity plan. Your peak rate is 31.9 cents per kilowatt hour.
The daily supply charge is 115.5 cents per day.
Compared to the Victorian Default Offer, this plan is estimated to cost less over twelve months.
Does anyone at the premises rely on life support equipment?
Do you hold a concession card such as a pension card?
Your connection date will be the 1st of October 2026.
You will also receive a 100 dollar gift card as part of this offer.
You have a 10 business day cooling off period during which you may cancel without penalty.
We will send you a welcome pack containing the full terms and conditions and the energy price fact sheet to j.smith@gmail.com.
Do you provide your explicit informed consent to proceed with this transfer?
You are free to end this call at any time. Thank you for your time today.
